crossRefs.note: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.
Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a…
but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”

translations.web: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
translations.bsb: Be merciful, just as your Father is merciful.
translations.kjv: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
translations.asv: Be ye merciful, even as your Father is merciful.
